name: Integrated Commissioning, Start-Up & Handover Chain

activities: construction complete per sub-system boundary
installation checks, inspection reports and A-punch clearance
mechanical completion certificate per system
walk-down and handover from construction to commissioning
sequence.note: Mechanical Completion (MC) is the gate: no pre-commissioning on a system before its MC and construction (A) punch clearance.

activities: static / cold testing: pressure & leak tests, continuity, insulation resistance
loop checks and instrument calibration (needs instrument air + control live)
motor solo / bump / rotation checks (needs power)
flushing, cleaning, drying of piping and vessels
sequence.note: Cold, no-load testing of individual components and loops; largely discipline-internal.

activities: energise switchboards and motor control centres (permanent power)
no-load / solo runs of pumps, compressors, fans, drives
establish enabling utilities (instrument air, cooling water, N2)
control-system I/O, interlock and cause-and-effect proving offline
clear B-punch that blocks live running
sequence.note: Everything up to but not including introduction of the real process medium; sub-system by sub-system.

activities: introduce process medium / first fill / first feed to each sub-system
wet / hot functional runs of equipment on real load
control loops in auto, tuning and trip testing live
system functional acceptance per commissioning package
sequence.note: First live operation of each individual system on its real medium.

activities: run interconnected systems together across battery limits
plant-wide cause-and-effect / ESD and interlock proving
sequence and interlock verification between upstream/downstream systems
control-room integrated operation from DCS/BMS
sequence.note: The heart of MEP/industrial commissioning: systems proven individually are now proven to work together as a plant.

activities: performance / guarantee test at design throughput and quality
reliability / availability run over an agreed continuous period
energy, yield and emissions verification against guarantees
stable start-up to design operating point
staged ramp-up of production rate
operations team takeover under supervision
final punch (C-punch) clearance
as-built, dossier, spares and training complete
commissioning / acceptance certificate and care-custody-control transfer
warranty / defects liability period start

work_packages.wp: Static / cold testing (pressure, loop, insulation, calibration)
Permanent power energisation & motor solo runs

typical_relationships.before: Mechanical completion & construction (A) punch clearance for a system
typical_relationships.reason: A system must be mechanically complete and its blocking construction punch cleared before it can be energised or run.

typical_relationships.after: Motor solo runs and any live equipment test
typical_relationships.reason: No rotating equipment or powered device can be run before its permanent power supply is energised.

typical_relationships.before: Instrument air available & control system live
typical_relationships.reason: Loop checks need the control system live and pneumatic valves need instrument air to stroke.

typical_relationships.before: Enabling utilities established (air / cooling water / N2 / steam / fuel)
typical_relationships.after: Wet/hot commissioning of the consumer system
typical_relationships.reason: A consumer system cannot run on load until the utilities it depends on are available at the battery limit.

typical_relationships.before: Pre-commissioning (no-load / solo) complete for a system
typical_relationships.after: Commissioning (first medium introduced) for that system
typical_relationships.reason: Solo and interlock proving must pass offline before the real process medium is introduced, for safety and equipment protection.
Systems must each work alone before they are run together; integrated testing assumes each part is already proven.
A guarantee run at design throughput is only meaningful once the interconnected plant operates correctly and safely.
Care-custody-control and ramp-up follow demonstrated performance; you do not hand over an unproven plant.
Formal handover cannot be certified until outstanding punch items and completion documentation are closed.
Downstream systems need feed from upstream; commissioning generally follows the process flow direction.

interfaces.requirement: Permanent power energised (switchgear, MCCs, distribution) before any live running, motor solo or wet commissioning.
Control system (DCS/PLC) live, I/O checked and cause-and-effect available before functional and integrated commissioning.
Enabling utilities (instrument air, cooling water, nitrogen, steam, fuel) available before commissioning their consumer systems.
BMS/plant control integrated and graphics live for monitored, interlocked integrated operation.
Process/mechanical equipment mechanically complete, aligned, grouted and pre-commissioned before hot runs.
Interconnecting piping erected, tested, flushed and reinstated before medium is introduced across the battery limit.
Fire protection commissioned and available as a safety pre-condition before plant start-up / hot commissioning.
All construction-punch (A) items affecting the system cleared at mechanical completion.

testing_requirements: Mechanical completion certification per sub-system with A-punch cleared
Static / cold tests: pressure, leak, insulation resistance, continuity
Instrument loop checks and calibration certificates
Motor solo / rotation / vibration baseline runs
Functional (wet/hot) test of each system on its real medium
Integrated cause-and-effect / ESD / interlock proving across systems
Performance / guarantee test at design duty
Reliability / availability run over the agreed continuous period
Handover dossier, as-builts, spares and training verification
commissioning_dependencies: Permanent power energised (the master gate for live running)
Control system (DCS/BMS/PLC) live and cause-and-effect available
Enabling utilities available (instrument air first, then cooling water, N2, steam, fuel)
Fire & life-safety systems commissioned before start-up
Upstream (feed) systems commissioned before downstream (product) systems
typical_exceptions: Buildings use a lighter path (pre-functional checklist -> functional -> integrated systems test -> seasonal/deferred test) versus a heavy industrial start-up/ramp-up
Some systems commission cold-only (no process medium) and skip the wet/hot stage
Performance/guarantee testing may be deferred to a seasonal window (e.g. HVAC summer/winter) after handover
On fast-track plants, sub-system handover (partial CoC) precedes whole-plant performance test
Reliability run duration and pass criteria are contract-specific and may be waived by agreement
evidence: A commissioning, integrated-test, performance-test or start-up activity is scheduled ahead of its enablers — mechanical completion, permanent power, control-system live, enabling utilities, or the prerequisite individual-system commissioning — collapsing the mandatory testing -> pre-commissioning -> commissioning -> integrated -> performance -> start-up -> handover order.
